coder_notes: Basket trial of IDH1/2-mutant solid tumours (cholangiocarcinoma, chondrosarcoma, glioma, others). Glioblastoma is named only in keywords; IDH mutation is mandatory so the glioma population is IDH-mutant, which the manual treats as not glioblastoma. Adjudicator should decide between not_glioblastoma and basket_gbm_eligible. Primary CNS tumours are allowed per exclusion criterion 6 wording.
